recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-18985 unless a future work group decision asks for different wording beyond the published correction.
issue_request: FHIR-18985 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core BaseResource. It reported that the Resource metadata table still showed the old Meta.profile type even though the displayed Meta StructureDefinition had been updated, and asked for the table column to mention canonical.
initial_application: No reachable commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-18985 or GF#18985 was found. Git history shows commit 3711daf34c0bfd80da9afe8a6c468dcb2cc37d6e changed source/resource/resource-notes.xml from uri to canonical for the profile row on 2018-10-10, and later edits preserved the correction.
additional_context: Resource is active in current build scope through fhir.ini, and Meta is an active normative datatype. The Meta datatype spreadsheet source already lists Meta.profile as canonical(StructureDefinition), and generated-looking Resource page fragments also show canonical(StructureDefinition). Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record; Jira search found no tightly related final core issue needing a separate decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the requested correction in both the Resource metadata table and the underlying Meta datatype source.
